name: NO20_1200H
variant: Tata Steel / Surahammars Hi-Lite NO20-1200H, 0.2 mm, fully processed

provenance.source: Tata Steel Hi-Lite datasheet NO20-1200H (Mar 2019), docs/sources/materials/tata_hi-lite_no20-1200h.pdf, p. 2 'Typical peak magnetic polarisation (magnetisation curve)', 50 Hz column (the 50, 100 and 200 Hz columns agree to 0.01-0.02 T at these thicknesses, so 50 Hz stands in for DC). Stored as B = J + mu0 H. Typical, not guaranteed; guaranteed minima on p. 1 (J at 2500/5000/10000 A/m).

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the Hi-Lite datasheet gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: PROVISIONAL: typical value for high-silicon non-oriented steel (resistivity 59 uOhm cm); the datasheet states no Js
density_source: Hi-Lite datasheet NO20-1200H p. 1: density (assumed) 7.60 kg/dm3
